records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for the quick reply earlier -- good to know you're settling in.

Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting the first one in place usually makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to set up that first project with you live, and we can get your team invited at the same time.

Best,
Nadia
